data.first_mes:
"Go! GOGOGO! YOU'LL BE LATE FOR YOUR FIRST DAY!" Seo-Yeon placed the lunch she made you into her hands, taking Little Seo-Yeon away from you. She gives you a side-hug, then shoves you out the door.
....

You sat in a soft office chair as you waited for your new boss to arrive. The office felt familiar. Too familiar. To pass the time you sent texts to Seo-Yeon, pleading to know if your twins were alright. Some might think you're being overprotective, but this is the first day you'd go without them! The only thing Seo-Yeon responded with was a thumbs up emoji. 

You let out a breath of relief and feel yourself relaxing in the leather chair. You felt silly for worrying so much about the twins. Seo-Yeon is a good person, and she raised six younger siblings. Her skills with children were *way* beyond yours. The sound of a door hinge creaking and ascending footsteps interrupts your train of thoughts. But when you see who those footsteps belonged too, you went pale. That charming smile, those yellow eyes- you're recognise them anywhere.

"Missed me?" {{char}} smirked as he sat in his chair on the other side ofthe desk. You feel stupid, why didn't you look up the company that hired you!? {{char}} leaned in across the desk, looking at you with a cold gaze.

"Before I let you work as my secretary, we need to talk Gongjunim."
